emi.sidebar.type.workstation.description: Displays recipes valid for the open workstation
remi.configuration.title: Reliable EMI Config
remi.configuration.searchById.tooltip: Include item registry IDs (e.g. minecraft:stick) when searching item names. Disable to only match displayed item names.
remi.configuration.searchModPrefix.toolt: Enable using the @ prefix in the search bar to filter items by mod name or mod ID.
remi.configuration.searchTagPrefix.toolt: Enable using the # prefix in the search bar to filter items by item/block/fluid/entity tags.
remi.configuration.searchTooltipPrefix.t: Enable using the $ prefix in the search bar to filter items by tooltip text.
remi.configuration.showCreativeTabNameIn: Show Tab Name in Search Bar
Displays the name of the currently selected creative mode tab in the EMI search bar when hovered.
remi.configuration.switchToSearchTabWhen: Switch to Search Tab When Searching
If enabled, typing in the search bar switches to the Search Items tab, and clearing the search bar switches back to the previously selected tab.
remi.configuration.maxSidebarTabs.toolti: Number of creative mode tabs to show on the sidebar per page (0 = auto based on available space).
remi.configuration.enableCreativeModeTab: Enable or disable the Creative Mode Tabs sidebar entirely.
remi.configuration.creativeTabSidebarTar: Select which sidebar panel the Creative Mode Tabs bar will appear on.
remi.configuration.creativeTabTheme.tool: Choose the orientation of Creative Mode Tabs. Default is Vertical for sidebars with the Vanilla theme and Horizontal for Transparent/Modern.
remi.configuration.tabAlignment.tooltip: Align tabs to the Start/Middle/End or Stretch to fit available space.
remi.configuration.verticalTabsWidth.too: Width of each tab when in vertical orientation.
remi.configuration.verticalTabsHeight.to: Height of each tab when in vertical orientation.
remi.configuration.horizontalTabsWidth.t: Width of each tab when in horizontal orientation.
Height of each tab when in horizontal orientation.
remi.configuration.creativeTabsIndex.too: Show Creative Mode Tabs bar when viewing the Index sidebar.
remi.configuration.creativeTabsCraftable: Show Creative Mode Tabs bar when viewing the Craftables sidebar.
remi.configuration.creativeTabsWorkstati: Show Creative Mode Tabs bar when viewing the Workstation sidebar.
remi.configuration.creativeTabsFavorites: Show Creative Mode Tabs bar when viewing the Favorites sidebar.
remi.configuration.syncSelectedCreativeM: If enabled, selecting a tab in Reliable EMI will select it in the Creative Inventory and vice versa.
remi.configuration.disabledCreativeModeT: Configure which Creative Mode Tabs are hidden from the Reliable EMI sidebar.
remi.configuration.enableStackGroups.too: Enable or disable collapsing item groups (like enchanted books or potions) into single entries.
remi.configuration.stackGroupsIndex.tool: Enable item stack grouping in the Index sidebar.
remi.configuration.stackGroupsCraftables: Enable item stack grouping in the Craftables sidebar.
remi.configuration.stackGroupsWorkstatio: Enable item stack grouping in the Workstation sidebar.
Enable item stack grouping in the Favorites sidebar.
remi.configuration.enableCreateStackGrou: Enable or disable the button in tag recipes to quickly create a stack group.
remi.configuration.disabledStackGroups.t: You must be in a world to manage Stack Groups.
When in Cheat Mode, dragging items from the sidebar directly into an inventory screen will cheat them into your inventory. Shift drag to copy entire stacks.
remi.configuration.emiOnlyInRecipeBook.t: When enabled, EMI will only be active when the vanilla Recipe Book is toggled open.
remi.configuration.disableEmiGlobalConfi: Prevents EMI from applying settings from the global config file (~/.minecraft/global/emi/global.css), forcing it to use the instance config.
remi.configuration.disablePaginationWrap: Don't wrap around to the first/last page.
remi.configuration.scrollInsteadOfPagina: Disable pages and scroll through items one row at a time instead.
remi.configuration.verticalScrollbar.too: In scroll mode, use a vertical scrollbar instead of the default horizontal progress bar.
remi.configuration.showTitleInsteadOfPag: (Always enabled in Scroll Mode) Hide page numbers and show the title of the page instead. If using creative tabs, the active creative tab title is used for the Index page.
remi.configuration.hidePageButtonWhenOne: Hide the sidebar page switching button if there's only one page in the sidebar.
remi.configuration.incrementalScrollbarF: Fill the sidebar scrollbar from left to right as you scroll or page through, instead of showing a discrete chunk.
remi.configuration.searchWidgetAlignWith: Align Search Widget With Bottom of Panel
Align search widget with the bottom of the panel.
remi.configuration.searchWidgetWidth.too: Modify the search widget width in pixels relative to panel width.
remi.configuration.searchWidgetHorizonta: Add extra space to the left and right
remi.configuration.searchWidgetVerticalP: Add extra space to the top and bottom
remi.configuration.searchWidgetSuggestio: Text color for the placeholder search bar text
remi.configuration.searchWidgetTextColor: Text color for the actively searching search bar text
remi.configuration.searchWidgetUseVanill: Revert the search widget background and highlight box to EMI's original texture and sizing, ignoring the padding options above.
remi.configuration.enableCategorizedTagP: Split EMI tag recipes into separate category tabs for Item, Block, Fluid, and Entity Tags.
remi.configuration.enableEntityTags.tool: Register entity type tags in EMI so right-clicking spawn eggs displays their entity tags.
remi.configuration.enableTagSearchEnhanc: Enable searching entity type tags and fluid tags in the index using the # tag search prefix.
